motion.name: known-task-progress
motion.purpose: Animate only known task progress changes; static under NO_COLOR or REDUCED_MOTION.

narrative.overview: A terminal change-control register separating active work, checked tasks and historical records.
keyCharacteristics: Task-first exact counts and independent planning
Explicit unknown, pending, failed and zero-task states
Single context-preserving Document, Source and Diff reader
dos: Lead with exact checked tasks and remaining work, then independent planning.
Keep keyboard focus visible without color.
donts: Do not invent progress for unknown totals.
Do not write from Changes or Archive.
